title: Dactyl 0.9 cloud integration and release workflow hardening
intent: Upgrade Decapod's backend=cloud todo bridge to Dactyl 0.9.0, preserve the single route-selection boundary, make cloud todo state/event transitions atomic, and repair release-PR and post-release master validation failures. Prove all locally available behavior and publish one reviewable PR. Hosted Neon/Vercel deployment, tenant isolation, and service-side event parity are explicitly outside this PR; do not claim them as stable.
stop_conditions: Do not claim live cloud stability until hosted service proof is available
